definitions.explanation: The discovery or revelation of something that was hidden, especially wrongdoing, crimes, or scandals.

examples.japanese: {不正|ふせい}が{発覚|はっかく}した。
{事件|じけん}が{発覚|はっかく}して{大|おお}きなニュースになった。
examples.english: The incident was exposed and became big news.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{横領|おうりょう}が{内部|ないぶ}{調査|ちょうさ}で{発覚|はっかく}した。
examples.english: Years of embezzlement was discovered through an internal investigation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不正|ふせい}が{発覚|はっかく}する - misconduct comes to light
・{事件|じけん}が{発覚|はっかく}する - an incident is exposed
・{発覚|はっかく}を{恐|おそ}れる - to fear discovery
・{発覚|はっかく}を{免|まぬが}れる - to escape detection

USAGE NOTES:
Typically used with the intransitive pattern: Xが{発覚|はっかく}する (X comes to light)
Almost always refers to negative things being discovered.

RELATED WORDS:
・{隠蔽|いんぺい} - concealment (what is done before {発覚|はっかく})
・{暴露|ばくろ} - exposure (active revelation by someone)
